claims: SpaceX successfully launched 25 Starlink satellites from California's Vandenberg Space Force Base via a Falcon 9 rocket on April 6, 2026.
Falcon 9 first-stage booster for the April 6, 2026 launch from Vandenberg SFB landed on a droneship in the Pacific Ocean.
Falcon 9 mission NG-24 is scheduled for April 8, 2026 from SLC-40, Florida.
NG-24 mission features a landing zone recovery.
Starlink mission is scheduled for April 9, 2026 from SLC-4E, California.
April 9, 2026 Starlink mission uses a droneship for recovery.
Next test flight of Starship is the 10th test flight.
10th test flight of Starship is slated for early to mid-May 2026.
10th test flight of Starship is to test orbiting SpaceX satellites.
Over 10,000 Starlink satellites are now functional in orbit.
Many missions utilize Falcon 9 boosters that have flown over 30 times
